Stainless Steel 14" x 34" Long Kick Plate

This 14" x 34" Long Kick Plate is made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel. It has an satin stainless steel. Packaged with matching brass mounting screws for easy installation.

Specifications of the 14" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Width: 14"
  • Plate Length: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Made to order. NOT Returnable.
